name: Board
summary: Work as cards in columns by stage (To do, In progress, Done): drag a card to another column or position, or move it with its Move menu. The columns scroll sideways inside the board when they don't fit. For a kanban board, a pipeline of deals or applications. Not for a table of records (DataTable) or a single ordered list (List with reordering).
a11y: Each column is a labelled section with a heading and its count ("3 of 4" against a limit); cards are list items. Dragging is never the only way: every card has a Move menu that names the columns, and each move is announced ("Moved Sign-in error to Done"). The drop target shows an accent outline only while a card is over it. Tags carry their meaning in words.
